meal.title: Deposit Function – Full Validation
meal.objective: Create a deposit() function that repeatedly asks for a positive numeric amount and returns it.

voice.script: What if you could guarantee a valid deposit amount with just one function? How do you keep asking until the user enters a positive number? We define a deposit function that loops until the input passes all checks. First, the function asks for a deposit amount. It uses the digit check to see if the entry contains only numbers. If not, it tells the user to enter only digits and starts the loop again. If the entry is numeric, it converts the text to an integer. Then it compares the number to zero; if it is not greater than zero, it informs the user and repeats. When both tests succeed, the function returns the valid amount. Here is the complete deposit function. When you run the program, it will keep prompting until you type a positive number. The flow diagram shows the loop returning to the prompt on invalid input. A function can enforce input rules by looping until the data is valid. Add a second function that asks for a bet amount using the same pattern.
